baselineTests: 98 pass / 0 fail on origin/main before any edit (npm test, node 24.11.1 local)
missionPremise: _decisions/2026-08-18_template_city_becomes_fixture_city.md active 2026-08-18: template-city becomes a fixture city carrying records generated from the adapter output contracts, empty-city keeps the honest-empty demonstration, and the five-part labelling gate is mechanical rather than editorial. The design reason is 30b law 3 (quiet on satisfied, loud on unresolved): with zero records nothing is unresolved and the system's tension mechanism is switched off.
completionPredicate: empty-city pack exists public-free generating nothing; a records dimension on the pack; src/fixtures.mjs generates deterministically from a record shape declared beside ADAPTER_KINDS; Development services four metric tiles and the Pipeline tab render generated records on template-city and stay honest-empty on empty-city; each of the five labelling-gate items has a named test; grantedAdapters zero on every pack; G-24 stays zero; web/shell.css byte-identical to origin/main; no new CSS class.
scopeBasis: One lens deep, Development services only. Not G-52, not a real adapter run, not G-24, not live Bastrop, not the top bar or left nav (lane B76 owns web/shell.css and the shell-top / shell-nav blocks in web/index.html).

design.recordShape: RECORD_SHAPES declared as a data table beside ADAPTER_KINDS in src/adapters.mjs. A common envelope (recordId, kind, recordType, cityKey, origin, accessPolicy, provenance) plus per-kind fields. mygov declared in full (permit-case: identifier, subject, stage, place, status, dueOffsetDays). The other six kinds get an explicit undeclared entry with a basis rather than silence, so an absent shape is a positive determination (DEV_PROCESS 4.3) and a completeness test can enumerate every ADAPTER_KINDS id.
design.statusVocabulary: Exactly the four in-flight states the 30c Development services metric strip names: overdue, in-review, awaiting-applicant, ready-to-issue. Each carries a declared semantic severity (crit/info/warn/ok) and a resolution flag; the renderer maps severity to a kit pill class. The contract declares meaning, never a CSS class.
design.packDimension: generatesFixtures boolean plus an explicit environment field on the pack. Law: generatesFixtures true requires environment demo AND grantedAdapters empty, asserted in assertCityPackShape. The second half is the mechanical form of the ruling's separation (a pack carries generated fixtures or a real city's granted records, never both) and of this card's hard constraint that grantedAdapters stays empty.
design.determinism: FNV-1a seed over cityKey plus kind into mulberry32, drawing from declared vocabularies against a declared per-status plan. No Math.random, no Date.now, no absolute dates: due is stored as an integer day offset and rendered as a relative phrase, so nothing flaps and no invented last-synced time appears.
design.cityKeyResolution: Existing resolveStaffMapQuery in src/staff-map.mjs (?cityKey=, default template-city). No second resolver invented.
design.route: GET /api/lenses/development-services/pipeline registered BEFORE the generic /api/lenses/ handler, tenancy-gated through the existing resolveCaller / packReadStatus pair.

adversarialFindings.finding: The kit shipped in this repo cannot draw the queue's 3px severity rail or the Unchecked hatch. web/shell.css defines .rail only inside .srcreg, with ok/partial/Mounted/Island variants and no critical variant, and the repo has no .mx matrix classes at all. The dispatch's 'the amber rail and the hatch actually render' is therefore not achievable on the Pipeline queue with existing classes.
adversarialFindings.disposition: Build the queue from .dt with .id/.subj and carry status on .pill p-crit / p-warn / p-info / p-ok, which is the only loudness the shipped kit can express. Do not add a class. Report the gap as a system gap per 30b section 4.

adversarialFindings.finding: The Development services nav badge and page-header chip both read Empty and a ui.test asserts they agree. Once template-city renders fourteen cases, a chip reading Empty is a false claim, but the nav badge lives inside <nav class="shell-nav">, which lane B76 owns and this card must not edit.
adversarialFindings.disposition: Leave both static values Empty so the static agreement test still measures what it measures, and set both at runtime from one function in web/app.js so they cannot diverge. app.js is not in the region B76 owns and no line inside shell-top or shell-nav is edited. A test asserts both are set from the same source (DEV_PROCESS 2.4).

adversarialFindings.finding: Generating parcel ids in the 48021 range would attach invented permit cases to real Bastrop County parcels, which is gate item 3 and the G-74 identity collapse in a new costume.
adversarialFindings.disposition: Fixture records carry no parcel node id at all. Place is an invented block-and-lot label with no street address. The gold parcel 48021:34137 stays the single labelled demo fixture on the Place tab and is not touched.

adversarialFindings.finding: 30b's queue column order includes people and money. Both are prohibited here (no staff name, no work-order assignee, no money collected, no payment complete).
adversarialFindings.disposition: Omit both columns entirely rather than invent obviously-fake ones. Deliberate exclusion, recorded here so a successor can tell it from an oversight (DEV_PROCESS 3.3).

adversarialFindings.finding: city-pack.test.mjs asserts exactly two packs and server.test.mjs asserts one anonymously-visible pack. Adding empty-city changes both measured facts.
adversarialFindings.disposition: Update those assertions to the new measured values rather than loosen them to inequalities. A count that stops counting is not a control.

adversarialFindings.finding: A fixture record that leaves the surface (an API response pasted into a ticket, an MCP read) must still say it is a fixture.
adversarialFindings.disposition: origin: fixture plus fixture: true plus a fixtureBasis string are required fields on the envelope, enforced by assertRecordShape, which the generator runs over every record it emits. The chrome label is additional, never the only mark.
